summary: Recoil Rocket is a 90-second space shooter where every shot blasts your rocket backwards, so you aim, dodge, and fly with the same cannon — bouncing blasts off indestructible asteroids into wobbling aliens, catching dropped stars, and keeping invaders away from the purple planet at the bottom. Play with Arrows/WASD to fire in that direction (and get kicked the opposite way), ricochet shots for bonus “PING!” points, fly through a star to load the piercing Star Cannon and fire it with Space, and survive the full invasion without letting three aliens hit the planet or crashing three times.
